name: Color Palette Generator
description: Generate complementary, analogous, triadic, split-complementary, or monochromatic color palettes from any base color, with one-click copy for each swatch.

faq.question: How are these palettes actually generated?
faq.answer: By converting your base color to HSL and rotating its hue around the color wheel by a fixed amount for each scheme (180° for complementary, ±30° for analogous, and so on) — real color-wheel math, not a lookup table of preset combinations.

faq.question: Which scheme should I use?
faq.answer: Complementary (opposite hues) gives high contrast and energy; analogous (neighboring hues) feels calm and cohesive; triadic (evenly spaced) is vibrant while staying balanced; split-complementary softens a complementary pair; monochromatic (one hue, varying lightness) is the safest choice for a clean, unified look.
